title: OpenProposal round-trip differences
description: The cells where the tables rendered from the model differ from the specification's, each with the decision record that makes the model differ there. The round-trip gate fails on a difference this file doesn't record, and on a recorded difference that no longer occurs.

table.description: The IR table ID, such as `table:5.2:1`, or the distribution's section for one of its figures.

row.description: The IR element of the row, or the model's name for a row the specification lacks, such as `Commitment.note`.

column.description: The column's header, normalized; `*` for a row only one side has.

spec.description: The specification's cell, as `npm run render` prints it. The gate compares it, normalized, with the cell.

model.description: The cell rendered from the model, as `npm run render` prints it.

decision.description: The decision record that makes the model differ. It covers an element the row rests on.

reason.description: Why the model differs here, in one or two sentences.

locks.description: Lock names the difference occurs on. Without it, it occurs on every lock.
